sections.label: Our Story
sections.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: Ophthalytics was founded with a simple but urgent mission: prevent avoidable blindness through early detection.
We saw how specialist shortages, long wait times, and unequal access to care left millions undiagnosed until it was too late.
By combining AI with clinical expertise, we empower frontline healthcare providers to deliver sight-saving screenings—when and where patients need them most.

sections.label: Our Mission
sections.heading: Our Purpose
paragraphs: To amplify the expertise of real doctors with AI-assisted diagnostic tools, delivering faster and more affordable retinal screenings to clinics that need them most.

sections.label: Our Vision
sections.heading: Our Vision
paragraphs: AI-driven predictive health through non-invasive, accessible eye scans—enabling earlier disease detection and better outcomes.

bio.tagline: Machine Learning, Data Science Expert & AI Junkie
paragraphs: Awais is a visionary healthcare innovator and data scientist. Blending innovation with compassion, he has used knowledge engineering—commonly called artificial intelligence, or AI—to greatly expand the access, accuracy, and efficiency of diagnosis. Under his leadership, the company has won accolades, such as the Health Equity Initiative award from Amazon Web Services, for its transformative impact.

With more than 15 years of experience in advanced data analytics, Awais previously led AI product development for GE Companies, contributing advances in deep learning, generative AI, computer vision, and enterprise architecture.

sections.heading: Join Us
sections.body: Take the first step toward an exciting career with Ophthalytics. Join our team and be a part of our mission to advance wellbeing through deep-learning AI. We are looking for driven and passionate individuals who share our vision and want to make a meaningful impact. Don't wait — start your journey with us today.
